name: HybridNeRF
definition: A hybrid surface–volume representation that renders most of the scene as surfaces (using few samples) while modeling challenging regions (thin structures, semi-opaque areas) volumetrically, using spatially-varying surfaceness parameters β(x).
summary: HybridNeRF combines explicit surfaces with implicit volumes using spatially varying surfaceness to achieve high-fidelity, real-time novel-view synthesis.
